The line has slope $\frac13$. On the curve,
\[\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{2t+2}{3t^2-3}=\frac{2}{3(t-1)}\quad(t\ne\pm1).\]
Setting this to $\frac13$ gives $t=3$. ($t=-1$ makes both derivatives zero, so there is no tangent direction there.) The point is \boxed{(18,\ 15)}.
